```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

read in data
```{r}
key.long <- read.csv("../data/derived/timepoint_key_long.csv")
met <- read_excel("../data/raw/urine-metabolomics/Dan Urine Anthocyanin 11-10-2022.xlsx", sheet = "concentration ng mL") %>%
  filter(!is.na(`21-V2`))
```

```{r}
met <- met %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-...1), ~as.numeric(.)) %>%
  mutate_at(vars(-...1), ~replace(., is.na(.), 0)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = 2:81, 
    names_to = "Sample",
    values_to = "value",
    values_transform = ~ as.numeric(gsub(",", "", .x))
  ) %>%
  rename("metabolite" = `...1`) %>%
  separate(Sample, c("Subject.Number", "v")) %>%
  mutate(v = toupper(v))
```
prep key
```{r}
key.long <- key.long %>%
  mutate(v =  toupper(substr(timepoints, 11, 12)),
         v = ifelse(v == "-V", toupper(substr(timepoints, 12, 13)), v),
         Subject.Number = as.character(Subject.Number)) %>%
  select(Subject.Number, v, Timepoint) 

# join to met 
met <- met %>%
  left_join(key.long)
```

Note: key.long doesn't include participants 84, 101, 102 that are present in metabolomics data
Would like to check that the timepoint key includes all participants as it was developed early on...

plot metabolites
```{r}
met$Timepoint <- factor(met$Timepoint, levels=c("rP", "tP", "rB", "tB"))

met %>%
  filter(!is.na(Timepoint)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Timepoint, y = value)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(metabolite ~ .) +
  xlab("") +
  ylab("ng/mL") + 
  theme(base.size = 10) +
  theme_bw()

ggsave("../figures/metabolomics_boxplot.png", dev="png", height = 6, width = 4, dpi = 400)
```
